# Expose bundle impact tool — corrected: add `target_path` cross-project routing

## Problem (corrected 2026-07-27)

`adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact` is deployed and callable, but its schema lacks the `target_path` / `target_confirmed` / `confirmationEvidence` parameters that every peer mutation tool exposes (`adv_change_archive`, `adv_change_close`, `adv_change_create`, `adv_delta_add`, etc.). The execute path resolves the session project via `getProjectId(store.paths.root)` and builds the workflow handle from that project ID. Cross-project calls (ADV session in project A declaring on a change in project B) fail with `WorkflowNotFoundError` because the workflow is looked up under the wrong project ID.

## Reproduction (this operator session, 2026-07-27)

Calling the tool from a **toolbox** session against `addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp` (an **advance** change):

```
Error: workflow not found for ID: adv/change/3f9f88.../addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp
errorClass: WorkflowNotFoundError
```

`adv_tool_invoke` with `target_path` / `target_confirmed` / `confirmationEvidence` rejected them as `unrecognized_keys`.

## Correction from original 2026-07-25 proposal

The original premise ("live catalog returns TOOL_NOT_FOUND") was wrong. `adv_tool_catalog` lists the tool; source defines it at `plugin/src/tools/change.ts:2682`; deployed `dist/index.js` contains the name. The real gap is target_path routing. The original `pinBuildkitImage` trigger should be re-checked separately after this fix lands.

## Scope

- `plugin/src/tools/change.ts` — extend the `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact` schema and execute path with `target_path` routing following the `adv_change_archive` pattern (L1037-L1083).
- `plugin/src/tools/change.worker-bundle.test.ts` — add cross-project routing test (target_path set, signal fires on target workflow, readback returns persisted impact) and untrusted-target refusal test.
- No other tools touched in this change. `adv_change_update_issues` and `adv_conformance` also lack target_path — P25 related-scan, separate change.

## Verification

- Same-project existing tests pass unchanged.
- New cross-project test: `target_path` set + `target_confirmed: true` + `confirmationEvidence` → signal fires on TARGET workflow, readback returns persisted `worker_bundle_impact`.
- New untrusted-target refusal test: `target_path` without `target_confirmed` → structured error, no save, no signal.
- `adv_tool_catalog` lists `target_path`, `target_confirmed`, `confirmationEvidence` in argKeys.
- Live host-plugin call from toolbox session against advance change succeeds end-to-end (manual smoke after deploy).

## Notes

- This is a defect fix (tool shipped without surveying peer cross-project patterns). RCA preserved in the corrected problem statement.
- Origin: original 2026-07-25 change from pokeedge-web (premise misdiagnosed); re-evidenced 2026-07-27 from `addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp` session.

# Problem Statement (corrected)

## Original diagnosis was wrong

The original 2026-07-25 problem statement claimed the deployed ADV registry lacked `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact` ("live catalog/describe surface returns TOOL_NOT_FOUND"). Verification 2026-07-27 shows this premise is false:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `adv_tool_catalog` (live deployed) | Tool present: `argKeys:[changeId,kind,rationale]`, `realm:change`, `group:write`, `lifecycle:[proposal..release]` |
| Source definition | `plugin/src/tools/change.ts:2682` (full schema + execute) |
| Source signal | `plugin/src/temporal/messages.ts:398` (`workerBundleImpactSetSignal`) |
| Deployed artifact | `~/.local/share/Advance/plugin/dist/index.js` contains the name |
| Build identity | sha256:e0eee563... — current source build |

The tool is shipped and callable. `pinBuildkitImage`'s symptom (if it still reproduces) has a different cause.

## Actual problem: missing `target_path` cross-project routing

The tool schema lacks `target_path` / `target_confirmed` / `confirmationEvidence`, unlike peer mutation tools (`adv_change_archive`, `adv_change_close`, `adv_change_create`, `adv_delta_add`, etc.). The execute path:

```ts
// plugin/src/tools/change.ts L2730, L2737 (current)
const projectId = await getProjectId(store.paths.root);     // SESSION project root
const handle = getChangeHandle(bundle.client, projectId, changeId);  // workflow lookup
```

`store.paths.root` resolves to the calling session's project. When an ADV session in project A calls this tool against a change in project B, the workflow lookup uses the wrong project ID and returns `WorkflowNotFoundError`.

## Reproduction (2026-07-27)

Calling the tool from a **toolbox** ADV session against `addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp` (an **advance** project change):

```
Error: workflow not found for ID: adv/change/3f9f88dbc6c65a2463945f1cfda1fc59794f411d/addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp
errorClass: WorkflowNotFoundError
```

The project ID `3f9f88...` is toolbox; the change lives under `bdf259...` (advance). The signal never reaches the target workflow.

`adv_tool_invoke` with explicit `target_path` / `target_confirmed` / `confirmationEvidence` rejected them:

```
SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED
[{"code":"unrecognized_keys","keys":["target_path","target_confirmed","confirmationEvidence"]}]
```

## Impact

- Cross-project ADV sessions cannot declare worker-bundle impact on foreign changes.
- Release gate completion for cross-project changes is blocked at the workflow-projection level (the underlying git finalization may still succeed, but the workflow state becomes inconsistent — as observed with `addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp` where `finalization.status=shipped` but the release gate never converged).
- The Concord `registerAdvAdvanceMcpServer` bridge and any future cross-project work hits this same gap.

## Direction

Add `target_path` routing to `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact`, following the `adv_change_archive` peer pattern (`plugin/src/tools/change.ts` L1037-L1083). Small, focused, mechanical: schema additions + execute signature destructure + target-aware store resolution. No new helpers, no new validation, no spec-delta redesign.

# Agreement

## Objective

Add `target_path` cross-project routing to `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact` so an ADV session in project A can declare worker-bundle impact on a change in project B (e.g., a toolbox session declaring on an advance change). Follow the established peer pattern used by `adv_change_archive`, `adv_change_close`, `adv_change_create`, etc.

## Correction from original proposal

The original proposal (2026-07-25, from pokeedge-web) claimed the deployed ADV registry lacked the tool. That premise is false: the tool is in the deployed catalog (verified via `adv_tool_catalog`: 88 tools including `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact` with `argKeys:[changeId,kind,rationale]`), the source defines it at `plugin/src/tools/change.ts:2682`, and the deployed `dist/index.js` contains the name. The actual gap is cross-project routing.

## Evidence — the real bug

Reproduced 2026-07-27 in this operator session: calling `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact` on `addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp` (an advance-project change) from a toolbox ADV session returned:

```
Error: workflow not found for ID: adv/change/3f9f88.../addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp
errorClass: WorkflowNotFoundError
```

Root cause: the tool schema lacks `target_path`, so the execute path resolves the SESSION project (toolbox, `3f9f88...`) via `getProjectId(store.paths.root)` and builds the workflow handle from that project ID. The advance change lives under project ID `bdf259...`. Workflow lookup fails.

`adv_tool_invoke` also rejected `target_path`/`target_confirmed`/`confirmationEvidence` as `unrecognized_keys` per the strict Zod schema, confirming the parameters are genuinely absent (not just undocumented).

## Success Criteria

- `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact` accepts optional `target_path` / `target_confirmed` / `confirmationEvidence` arguments matching the peer shape used by `adv_change_archive` (L1037-L1083 of `plugin/src/tools/change.ts`).
- When `target_path` is provided and untrusted, the tool requires `target_confirmed: true` + `confirmationEvidence` and routes through the target store, exactly like `adv_change_archive`.
- When `target_path` is omitted, behavior is unchanged (session project).
- A cross-project call from a session in project A against a change in project B succeeds end-to-end (signal fires on the correct workflow; readback succeeds).
- Catalog/describe surface lists the three new argument keys.
- No regression to same-project (no target_path) usage.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact.args` includes `target_path: z.string().optional()`, `target_confirmed: z.literal(true).optional()`, `confirmationEvidence: z.string().optional()` with descriptions matching peer tools.
- AC2: Execute signature destructures `{ changeId, kind, rationale, target_path, target_confirmed, confirmationEvidence }` and resolves the store via the same target-aware resolver used by `adv_change_archive` (`{ store, target_path }` pattern at L1083).
- AC3: Untrusted-target validation matches peer tools: when `target_path` is provided and not in the trust set, `target_confirmed !== true` or empty `confirmationEvidence` returns a structured `Untrusted target_path mutation requires target_confirmed: true and confirmationEvidence` error.
- AC4: Workflow handle is built from the TARGET project ID when target_path is provided, not the session project ID.
- AC5: Existing same-project tests in `plugin/src/tools/change.worker-bundle.test.ts` continue to pass unchanged.
- AC6: New test case exercises cross-project routing: target_path set, target_confirmed=true, confirmationEvidence set, signal fires on the target project's workflow, readback returns the persisted `worker_bundle_impact`.
- AC7: `adv_tool_catalog` and `adv_tool_describe` expose the three new argument keys.
- AC8: Untrusted-target refusal test: target_path without target_confirmed returns the structured error and does NOT call `store.changes.save` or fire any signal.

## Constraints

- Follow the `adv_change_archive` peer pattern verbatim (L1037-L1083 of change.ts). No new resolver, no new validation helper.
- `kind` and `rationale` semantics unchanged. The declaration is still typed and signal-backed.
- Live `workerBundleImpactSetSignal` shape unchanged.
- No spec deltas beyond the tool surface change.
- Backward-compatible: all existing call sites (no target_path) continue to work.

## Avoidances

- Do NOT redesign worker-bundle provenance schema.
- Do NOT add target_path routing to other tools in this change (adv_change_update_issues, adv_conformance). Those are P25 follow-up scans; surface separately.
- Do NOT change the existing test fixture shape for same-project usage.
- Do NOT bypass the untrusted-target trust check.

## Out of Scope

- Adding target_path to `adv_change_update_issues`, `adv_conformance`, or any other tool lacking it. (P25 related-scan; separate change.)
- Redesigning the worker-bundle provenance authority flow.
- Verifying the original pokeedge-web `pinBuildkitImage` trigger (the original premise was misdiagnosed; the operator should re-check whether pinBuildkitImage still has any release-gate block after this fix lands).
documents.executiveSummary:
# Executive Summary

## Outcome

`adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact` now accepts `target_path` /
`target_confirmed` / `confirmationEvidence` and routes through the target
project's store + Temporal workflow when invoked cross-project. The bug that
blocked cross-project worker-bundle impact declarations (which I hit at the end
of `addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp` earlier in this session) is fixed at the source.

## Correction from the original 2026-07-25 proposal

The original proposal (from pokeedge-web) claimed the tool was missing from the
deployed catalog. Verification in this session (`adv_tool_catalog` showed it
listed with `argKeys:[changeId,kind,rationale]`; source grep found it at
`plugin/src/tools/change.ts:2682`) proved that premise wrong. The real gap was
the missing `target_path` cross-project routing that every peer mutation tool
already exposes.

## Why It Matters

Without this fix, any ADV session in project A trying to declare worker-bundle
impact on a change in project B fails with `WorkflowNotFoundError` because the
workflow handle is built from the SESSION project ID, not the target's. The
release-gate projection then refuses to converge, producing the symptom I
observed on `addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp` (finalization.status=shipped but release
gate never marked done). Cross-project ADV work — including any future Concord
coordination and the `registerAdvAdvanceMcpServer` bridge — hits this same gap.

## What was built

- **`plugin/src/tools/change.ts`** — `adv_change_set_worker_bundle_impact`
  refactored: schema +3 fields (spread from shared `targetPathSchema.shape`);
  body wrapped in `runSetImpact(activeStore, projectContext?)` inner function;
  `withTargetPathStore` wrapper when `target_path` is set; project ID resolution
  via `projectContext?.projectId ?? getProjectId(activeStore.paths.root)`.
- **`plugin/src/tools/change.worker-bundle.test.ts`** — 3 new tests: schema
  exposure check, cross-project success (target store/handle/context), and
  untrusted-target refusal (no save, no signal).

## Pattern source

Copied verbatim from `adv_change_close` (change.ts:2761-3091). No new helpers,
no new modules, no spec deltas.

## Verification

- `bin/oc-test targeted -- src/tools/change.worker-bundle.test.ts` → 10/10 pass
  (7 existing + 3 new).
- `pnpm run check` (typecheck, schemas:check, generate:manifests:check,
  test-isolation, lockfile-policy, lint, format:check) all green.
- TDD red `tr_ms3ww3yf` proves pre-change source had 0 target_path references
  in the tool.
- TDD green `tr_ms3wwde8` runs all 10 tests passing.
- Contract review matrix: 26/26 rows passing or respected; 0 failures.

## Release Readiness Summary

Tool-surface change to `plugin/src/tools/change.ts` (single tool refactored) +
3 new tests. No spec deltas, no workflow code change, no signal shape change.
Replay-determinism is unaffected because workflow code paths and signal
payloads are unchanged. The worker-bundle impact classification for THIS change
is `not_applicable` (rationale: tool definition is host-side, executes in
opencode; the signal it fires is unchanged; the workflow signal handler is
unchanged; only host-side routing logic was added).

## Remaining Risks and Follow-ups

- **Self-deployment chicken-and-egg**: this change fixes the tool needed to
  declare its OWN worker-bundle impact cross-project. Until the fix is deployed,
  the worker-bundle impact declaration on this change must be made either
  same-project (from an advance ADV session) or accepted via the same
  finalization-shipped-but-projection-inconsistent path observed on
  addDurableAdvAdvanceMcp.
- **Catalog readback**: AC7 verification (adv_tool_catalog lists 3 new argKeys)
  is deferred to post-deploy smoke.
- **P25 related-scan**: `adv_change_update_issues` and `adv_conformance` also
  lack target_path routing. Separate change.
- **Original `pinBuildkitImage` trigger**: the 2026-07-25 pokeedge-web premise
  was misdiagnosed. Operator should re-verify whether pinBuildkitImage still has
  any release-gate block after this fix lands.
